name: codemat
description: CodeMat (Comp & Mat) — learn programming and math with interactive exercises

scripts.apphosting:build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.apphosting:run: sh -c 'cd apps/web/.next/standalone && HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 exec node apps/web/server.js'
scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w apps/functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/functions
